args.title: Bellwether: Retail Returns Logistics – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, which makes returns a large cost for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days kept most of the margin, so speed matters for recovering value.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns ; https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion (subscriber access)
